Create consistent interaction patterns that let users stay informed, provide input and complete work across channels.

Develop conversational and agentic experiences, using evaluations and customer feedback to improve quality and reliability.
Own the feature lifecycle, from technical design and implementation through staged rollout, production operation and iteration.

Partner with Product, Design, Customer Success and customers to translate needs into clear requirements and practical solutions.
Write design documents and RFCs, build prototypes and communicate technical tradeoffs.
Raise engineering quality through code review, automated testing, documentation and operational excellence.
Use AI coding tools effectively and critically evaluate generated code for correctness, security, performance and maintainability.
Mentor engineers and contribute to a collaborative team with strong technical judgment and shared ownership.
Long-Term Strategic Impact:
Shape the architecture and technical direction of interfaces that connect people, agents and business processes.
Establish reusable patterns for integrations, interaction models and agent tooling as the product grows.
Improve scalability, observability and reliability while keeping the team’s ability to deliver quickly.
Help turn customer insights and emerging AI capabilities into a coherent product experience.
You’re Our Person If…
You have 6+ years of software engineering experience delivering production software, with scope and technical leadership appropriate to the Senior, Lead or Principal level.
You have strong proficiency in TypeScript/JavaScript and a modern backend language such as Go, Java or Python.
You have experience building customer-facing web applications with React or a comparable framework.
You have designed and implemented GraphQL or REST APIs and integrated with third-party services using webhooks and asynchronous communication.
You understand authentication and authorization patterns, including OAuth, SSO and secure service integration.
You have experience building and operating distributed systems or SaaS applications on a public cloud.
You take ownership from ambiguous requirements through production delivery, including monitoring and controlled releases.
You communicate clearly in writing and technical discussions, and collaborate effectively across engineering and product functions.
You use AI development tools thoughtfully to accelerate delivery while maintaining engineering standards.
Even Better If…
You have experience with MCP, LLM tool-calling, agent frameworks or evaluation-driven development.
You have built applications or integrations for Microsoft Teams, Microsoft 365, Copilot, Slack or email.
You have worked on conversational interfaces, notification systems or products that coordinate human and automated work.
You have experience with workflow engines, business process automation or task-management products.
You have hands-on experience with Go, GraphQL and PostgreSQL.
You have helped build a product from an early stage or worked on a small team balancing rapid delivery with enterprise reliability.
Unleash Your Potential
When you join Salesforce, you’ll be limitless in all areas of your life. Our benefits and resources support you to find balance and be your best , and our AI agents accelerate your impact so you can do your best . Together, we’ll bring the power of Agentforce to organizations of all sizes and deliver amazing experiences that customers love. Apply today to not only shape the future — but to redefine what’s possible — for yourself, for AI, and the world.

This policy applies to current and prospective employees, no matter where they are in their Salesforce employment journey. The same goes for compensation, benefits, promotions, transfers, reduction in workforce, recall, training, and education.
